name: Gemini
description: Google's Gemini in the AI Chat: with the Gemini CLI (your Google account), or with the Gemini API and an API key kept in your Keychain — no CLI needed.

mode.description: cli: the Gemini CLI, signed in with your Google account. api: the Gemini API with your API key (set the key with the Configure command, or the chat's agent picker).
